fullName:
com.blockether.spel.cli-integration-test.`discover-session-files` is the single source of truth behind `session list`,
   every `--all-sessions` sweep, and stale-daemon reaping. It scans the tmpdir
   for `spel-*.sock` — and a Unix domain socket is NOT a regular file, so a
   `.isFile` guard hid every live session: `session list` answered "No active
   sessions" while a daemon was serving commands..sees a real Unix domain socket, not only regular files
